_comment: Anima Aesthetic v1.1 - Text to Image (safetensors). Export (API) format for a bitGen Studio image style.
models/diffusion_models/anima-aesthetic-v1.1.safetensors (4.2 GB - fine-tuned on high-quality pictures: the one to start with)
MODELS (ComfyUI's OWN folders; circlestone-labs/Anima on Hugging Face - the CircleStone Labs Non-Commercial License: the
model and LoRAs non-commercial, the pictures it makes may be used commercially):
models/text_encoders/qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors   (Qwen3 0.6B - CLIPLoader type stable_diffusion; ComfyUI tells the
model from its weights. If your ComfyUI lists an 'anima' type, that works too)
Natively supported by ComfyUI (a 2B anime / illustration model - Danbooru tags, plain language or both). Settings from
the model card: 30-50 steps, cfg 4-5, sampler er_sde (euler_a softer lines, dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu more varied), 512 - 1536 px
(about 1 MP: 1024 x 1024, 832 x 1216 ...). Start the prompt with quality tags: 'masterpiece, best quality, score_7, safe, '
(the aesthetic model: leave the score_* tags out of both prompts). The negative is the card's.
LoRAs: 4 model-only slots (LoraLoaderModelOnly), bypassed when empty. The community Anima-2.9B (Gazingstars123/Anima-2.9B,
ComfyUI 0.33.1+) loads the same way - set the style's Model to its file.

inputs.text: worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, artist name, blurry, jpeg artifacts, chromatic aberration
